purpose: Level 2 STRUCTURAL: direct GET of the /Events page named in the RSS feed, to confirm (rather than infer from the RSS description alone) that its rendered event content is DICE-dependent.
method: curl -sS -L -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; BandOnTheMapResearch/1.0; +research)' --max-time 20 (single unauthenticated GET; no retries)
notable_finding: The page's own <script src> loads widgets.dice.fm's dice-event-list-widget.js, and the only event-related JS on the page is the DiceEventListWidget.create(...) call carrying MOTH Club's DICE partnerId/apiKey filtered to venues:['moth club']. No event titles, dates, or IDs are present anywhere in the static HTML itself -- all event rendering happens client-side, sourced from DICE's own API, not any first-party MOTH Club JSON/feed.
